title: Checkbox filter component audit
purpose: Audit checkbox as its own option component, not as a generic option list.
objective: Define checkbox anatomy, option layout, checked state, accessibility, responsive behavior, and styling backlog.
scope_boundary: In scope: group label, option label, checkbox input, selected state, option spacing, counts/visuals if supported, hover/focus/disabled, layout modes, and QA scenario. Out of scope: radio, chips, toggle, swatch, and implementation.
entry_condition: TASK-FC-001 has classified preset/widget setting ownership and current checkbox render/CSS/JS files are available.
exit_condition: A checkbox audit sheet exists with controls and states prioritized.

phases.title: States
phases.purpose: Define checked, hover, focus, disabled, and empty states.

phases.title: Controls
phases.purpose: Separate shared option controls from checkbox-specific controls.

acceptance_criteria: Audit states which controls are shared and which are checkbox-specific.
No plugin source changes are made.
stop_conditions: Audit collapses checkbox into radio/chips without preserving semantics.
